title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle achieved a career-high 14 strikeouts, with no walks, in the Red Sox's 13-1 win over the Athletics.
The Red Sox extended their winning streak to nine games, backed by strong offense with 15 hits and multiple high-scoring innings.
Raymond Burgos had a successful Red Sox debut, pitching three scoreless innings with two strikeouts after being recalled from Triple-A.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez intensify training camp with dynamic matchups at New England Patriots practice.
Gonzalez uses strategic trash talk against Brown, aimed at improving both players for the upcoming NFL season.
Gonzalez, amidst contract negotiations, faces a challenging season against top receivers like Justin Jefferson and D.K. Metcalf.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman was acquired by the Red Sox from the Orioles in exchange for three prospects and Carlos Narvaez.
Rutschman is set to begin a rehab assignment with the Triple-A Worcester Red Sox due to wrist inflammation.
Interim manager Chad Tracy confirmed Rutschman will catch five innings and bat two or three times on Saturday.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' (2026) is available on Paramount+ and features Dave Bautista as an ancient warrior.
'You, Me & Tuscany' is a romantic comedy with Halle Bailey and Regé-Jean Page, streaming on Peacock.
'Sterling Point' Season 1, a YA drama, follows Annie as she inherits an island; available on Prime Video.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet may join the Red Sox bullpen in 2026 after an injury-plagued season disrupted his role as a starter.
Crochet, previously a successful starter for Boston, has begun short-distance throwing after shoulder and lat injuries.
Interim manager Chad Tracy noted Crochet's potential bullpen role, emphasizing caution about his workload as a starter.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: Ball python named 'Tippy' found near Ellington Street in Dorchester by community garden staff.
The snake was left in a cage and reported to Boston Animal Care and Control via 311.
Tippy is in good condition at the Roslindale animal care facility; officials seek information about the owner.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Tommy DeVito led Team Blue to a 22-15 victory over Team White in a Patriots training camp scrimmage.
DeMario Douglas excelled with six receptions for Team Blue, including a 50-yard touchdown from Tommy DeVito.
Patriots cornerback Carlton Davis remains sidelined, with Coach Mike Vrabel expecting him out until next week.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich was voted the best town on Cape Cod by over 850 Boston.com readers in an informal poll.
The Lower Cape town features nearly 11 miles of shoreline along the Nantucket Sound and Pleasant Bay.
Harwich offers a variety of attractions including conservation areas, community centers, and over 20 beaches.

title: DA’s office says prosecutor’s ‘hot mic’ moment in Lindsay Clancy trial was misheard
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: The DA's office claims the 'hot mic' remark was 'shut it off,' not 'shut her up,' regarding autopsy photos.
Defense attorney Kevin Reddington suggested the prosecutors made inappropriate comments during Lindsay Clancy's trial.
Judge William Sullivan warned courtroom participants against inappropriate comments, citing the presence of microphones.

title: Little boy dancing to DJ on Boston Common has hundreds of thousands of new fans
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A video of 4-year-old Chukwuemeka Ikesinachi-Nwogwugwu dancing on Boston Common has received over 200,000 likes.
Miss S. Peace, the DJ at the event, was hosting a popup show promoting human connection in public spaces.
Chukwuemeka's mother, Chidimma Ikesinachi, praised the positive response and support from Boston's community.
